items.Title: Marine Superintendent
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Communication
Internal Communication   Purpose
- Fleet Managers
- Technical Superintendents/ Vessel Masters
- Crewing team   - Liaise with Fleet Managers/Technical Superintendents to validate certifications and for smooth operations of the vessel
- Work with the Crewing team on crew travel, changes, and other personnel issues.
   
External Communication   Purpose
- Clients (Oil & Gas Majors) e.g., QatarEnergy, QATARGAS, Shell, TotalEnergies etc.
- Sub-contractors   - Liaise with the clients for smooth operations and compliance with contractual requirements
- Monitor performance and ensure smooth operations of sub-contracted vessels and Jack-up barges
items.ShortDescriptionStr: To ensure company-owned and managed vessels and Jack Up Barges comply with all statutory and legislative matters, with particular attention to the ISM/ISPS codes, class requirements/training/Contract compliance, and in accordance with all local and international laws and regulations. To participate in the effective and efficient management of Marine Resources in order to carry out all Marine functions within the business.
items.ExternalQualificationsStr:
Qualification/Experiences/Skills
Dimension   Minimum requirements
Education & Professional Qualification   - Unlimited Master Mariner's license in compliance with STCW II/2 or Graduation related to Maritime studies
Professional Experience   -Minimum 8-10 Years of Experience, Minimum 3 year shore experience as Port Captain or Marine Superintendent in Offshore Company with experience operating Jack-up barges.
Geographic Experience   Any location.
Computer Skills   - Proficient in Microsoft systems and electronic management systems and being able to maintain a database.
Language Skills   - Business fluent English (both written and spoken)
Market/Industry/Functional Knowledge   - Knowledge of good marine and Jack-up barges practice.

items.InternalResponsibilitiesStr:
Key Roles & Responsibilities
•   Ensure Company owned and managed vessels and Jack-up Barges comply with Class and Statutory regulations (MODU) and possess valid vessel and client certifications.
•   Liaise with the Crewing team regarding aspects of travel, crew changes, and other personnel issues in conjunction with the Vessel Master. Monitor crew overlap days.
•   Monitor crew compliance with Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW 95) and its subsequent amendments, Maritime Labour Convention 2006 (MLC), and other training requirements (as per Client requirements).
•   Inspect Vessels Planned Maintenance System to ensure its operating condition as per the Company Safety Management System (SMS) and its compliance with International Safety Management (ISM) code and MLC.
•   Ensure that all mandatory procedures i.e., Toolbox talks, Risk assessments, and permits to work systems are used effectively and filed for audit purposes.
•   Monitor that vessels / Jack-up barges carry and update, as required, necessary publications, procedures, operational manuals, and other documents required by the flag state and other regulatory bodies.
•   Ensure that International Marine Contractors Association (IMCA) guidelines and best industry practices are adhered to at all times, with regard to vessel Dynamic Positioning (DP) operations, equipment, and personnel requirements.
•   Inspect the fleet's DP equipment to ensure that it is in a fully operational state of readiness at all times.
•   Attend annual DP and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) trials of existing and newly Built vessels.
•   Undertake offshore visits to vessels / Jack-=up barges in order to conduct on-board inspections & training to the Officers and crew.
•   Visit locations for taking over new build vessels or inspect vessels / Jack-up barges, as required by the Management, in terms of compliance with Class and Statutory regulations.
•   Undertake visits of Manning Agencies from annual external ISO/ ISM audits
•   Participate in internal and external audits of vessels /Jack-up barges to ensure their operating condition as per the Company Safety Management System (SMS)
•   Conduct internal Offshore Vessel Inspection Database (OVID) inspections in preparation for all charterers.
•   Execute activities within the approved vessel's budget guidelines and communicate any deviations in advance to Line Manager
•   Assist in In-house Training on Ship Handling/DP simulator.
•   Ensure operations/work processes occur in accordance with all relevant legal, regulatory, and any other standards and requirements to which compliance is required.
•   Perform job-related duties as assigned.
•   To assist in Barge, move procedures (BMP) consulting with Marine Warranty Surveyor (MWS) on relevant information required for the BMP. 
•   Liaise with our design/drawing team for location drawings for new positions etc for Jack-up barges.
